ns2:course.label: Environmental Health
ns2:course.description: Appreciation of the concepts and mechanisms used to prevent or control environmental conditions that may lead to infectious or other environmentally induced diseases. Presents topics from a public health perspective that include air pollution, water supply management, waste management, radiation protection, food hygiene, occupational health and disaster management. 3 or 4 undergraduate hours. 3 or 4 graduate hours.
